body.subject: Codex judge verdict: item48-balances-chain-order-r3 = A
body.text: artifact=item48-balances-chain-order-r3 kind=code purpose=tri7 item 48 round 3 (round 2 was B, no blockers; round-2 polish items fixed, one extra hardening added after a rehearsal race: accept-time active guard): chain-ordered balances replay + guarded swap/verify/rollback deploy to DNS3, Pi, DNS2; decisions: commit+push to master, and deploy per brief section 7 worktree=/tmp/codex-judge-8vBoSc codex_grade=A judge=codex
reasons: Correct and complete chain-ordered replay implementation with explicit continuity, hole, genesis, and moving-tip handling.
Relevant Rust tests, archive rehearsals, supply cross-checks, Linux/Windows builds, acceptance-check selftests, and deployment failure-branch rehearsals all report success.
The prior blocking defects are fixed: advancing-chain snapshots are accepted correctly, restart failures route through rollback, and acceptance now checks that the unit remains active.
Source checksums match the supplied files, and read-only syntax/selftest checks passed.
polish_suggestions: In the deploy harness, rebuild the emitted common fields after the accept-time activity guard changes `reason`; otherwise a guard-triggered rollback can report the stale reason `check passed`.
Consider asserting that `running_sha256` equals `new_sha256` before emitting `accepted`, providing an additional explicit readback guarantee.
Remove or populate the empty `21_r1_verdict.json` evidence file.
